prompt: Make a TPM-oriented changelog video from the synthetic GitHub PR export implementing leader failover. The standup transcript suggests an automatic recovery guarantee that the code does not implement. Stop after the plan for approval; also describe the post-approval rendering and review correction protocol.
assertions: The output uses the PR only for implemented behavior, uses provided context for motivation and tradeoffs, introduces no inferred argumentative claims, and rejects seamless or transparent recovery claims.
The output uses a TPM treatment emphasizing boundaries, dependencies, rollout risk, interruption, and discussion points.
The renderer recommendation is based on explanatory primitives and explains why the alternative is weaker.
The output assigns all edits and renders to the coding/rendering agent and only verification to the review agent.
The output routes small implementation mismatches to the coding/rendering agent and higher-level changes to the user.
